Sri Lanka vehicle data, sketched

Built 26 Nov 2026 from the CSVs in data_praveen. Re-run scripts/20_build_sketch_overview.py to refresh. Press-sourced numbers are secondary (JB Securities, HNB, CBSL via newspapers).

1. Registrations per month

Registrations rose from 43.8K (Nov 2025) to a peak of 62.8K in May 2026, then eased. Feb 2026 is missing: no article gave the JB Securities figure.

Data: registrations_monthly_press_2025_2026.csv (JB Securities via Daily FT / Daily Mirror)

2. Brand-new cars by brand

BAW led in May, then BYD took over (519 in June, 800 in July). Perodua is steady but small. A 0 means the article did not report that brand that month. May is HNB's count, June and July are JB Securities'.

Data: registrations_by_brand_press_2025_2026.csv

3. The vehicles on the road

About 8.4 million vehicles in use in 2023. Motorcycles are the biggest group, then three-wheelers; cars are only about 0.9 million.

Data: vehicle_stock_by_type_2019_2023.csv (DCS Table 7.2)

4. Car registrations fell off a cliff

The import suspension shows up: new motor cars drop from about 38K (2019) to about 1.8K (2023), and hybrids collapse. 2025's rebound is not in this table (it ends at 2023).

Data: dmt_new_registrations_by_class_fuel_2019_2023.csv (DCS Table 7.3, DMT)

5. Distributor revenue

Group revenue. DIMO more than doubled (43.6 to 103.6) and United Motors grew 4.5x (11.6 to 52.4) since 2023/24. Lanka Ashok Leyland has no 2025/26 figure in our data (shown as 0).

Data: company_financials.csv (audited annual reports)

6. What vehicle imports cost

Roughly US$200-310M a month. December 2025 peaked at US$311M; June 2026 was US$182M. Months with no article are simply missing, not zero.

Data: vehicle_imports_cbsl_monthly.csv (CBSL as quoted by press)

7. Car imports (UN Comtrade)

Log scale (each gridline is 10x). Car imports collapse from about US$650M (2019) during the ban; electric cars go from US$0.5M (2017) to US$9M (2023) and US$37M (2024). 2018 is blank: the API returned nothing for that year.

Data: comtrade_sl_trade_clean.csv, world-total rows

8. Models per brand (our master list)

Toyota has the most models but none has a price yet; BYD and Mercedes follow. Chinese EV brands (BYD, BAW, Wuling...) are mostly hybrids and EVs, Toyota and Mercedes are mostly ICE.

Data: data/processed/master_sl_automotive.csv
